note: Data-platform gate. A method that consumes a modality listed here runs only when the member's data platform is in `allowed_platforms`. Proteomics methods not listed under `skills` are refused by default: most published protein clocks are trained on Olink NPX or SomaScan RFU and expect cohort-standardised values, and raw MS intensities fed to them produce numbers like 'brain age 140.5' without any error (longevity-skills audit, 2026-09-29).

default.reason: the skill does not document which assay its coefficients came from; refused until someone declares it here

plasma-proteomic-cellular-aging.reason: skill docs name SomaScan aptamer assay

plasma-proteomics-brain-immune.reason: skill docs name Olink; raw MS intensity returned 'brain 140.5 years' in the audit

proteomics.note_value_scale: A platform match is not enough: the value scale must match what the coefficients expect. Member data is almost never cohort-standardised, so cohort_z methods stay blocked until a reference cohort exists.

verified_by: grep of each skill's SKILL.md/skill.json for Olink/SomaScan/aptamer/mass-spec mentions, 2026-09-29
